sources.supports: Encoded receptor protein and engineered cell are distinct objects.
Specialized CAR can recognize a peptide in HLA context.

caption: The binding region faces outward and signaling domains face inward across one membrane. Generation labels count common signaling arrangements; extra domains do not rank benefit, and specialized peptide–HLA CARs exist.
alt: A CAR binding region and spacer extend outside the engineered cell, an anchor crosses its membrane, and costimulatory and CD3-zeta activation domains lie inside. Aligned generation strips keep activation in the same position and add zero, one or two costimulatory domains without ranking. Receptor, gene and cell differ; some CARs bind peptide-HLA.
